name: Hotplate
description: A single electric coil burner in an aluminium case. Heats a pot or pan when plugged in.
notes: 280 by 210 mm and 75 mm tall: alu-bare case on rubber feet, enamel-white top, a steel-stainless drip bowl under four iron-cast coil turns, a black knob, a red pilot lamp and a short cord. heating 2 stands for the reference's HOTPLATE quality. Mains power has no content field yet.

name: Induction hotplate
description: A flat black glass cooktop that heats steel and iron pans directly. Needs power.
notes: 290 by 350 mm and 60 mm tall: plastic-grey case, screen-black glass with a white cooking-ring mark, a sloped control strip with an lcd-green display and four buttons, and a cord out the back. The cord takes the box's longest side to 1.26 times the reference. Its need for ferrous cookware has no content field yet.

name: Makeshift vacuum sealer
description: A heated press bar and an aquarium air pump screwed to a board. Sucks the air out of a bag and seals it shut.
notes: A pine board 350 by 150 mm carrying a hinged aluminium press bar over a dark heating strip, a blue air pump with a clear hose to a steel nozzle beside the bar, a red switch, red wiring under grey tape and a mains cord. A crafted item, so it spawns rarely; Tier2 stands in for a scavenged find. vacuum_sealing is a new quality name for sealing food bags, which the reference gives no quality for.

name: Mess kit
description: A nested aluminium pot and frying pan with folding handles, packed together for carrying.
notes: An alu-bare pot 140 mm across with a frying-pan lid seated upside down on it, the pan's rubber-gripped folding handle swung over the top and the pot's wire bail folded against its side. cooking stands for the reference's COOK and BOIL qualities.

name: Microwave oven
description: A countertop microwave oven with a keypad and a dial. Heats food quickly when plugged in.
notes: A compact 400 by 300 mm unit 230 mm tall: paint-white case with vent slots, a black door with a screen-black window and grey bar handle, and a plastic-charcoal control panel with an lcd-green display, a twelve-key pad and a dial. The box is 3.8 times the reference's 9 L, which is smaller than any real microwave. baking 1 stands for the reference's OVEN quality, matching the oven workstation's quality name. A placed appliance could become a workstation once mains power exists.

name: Autoclave
description: A heavy steel pressure chamber that sterilises instruments with steam. It is disconnected from its supply.
notes: Rides on the microwave model in stainless steel, as the reference lists it as a microwave variant. A real benchtop autoclave is a round chamber behind a heavy door, and at 34.5 kg and 76 L it is far bigger than the shared model; it deserves its own model if it matters to play. Set its mass from the reference when the drafts are applied. Sterilising has no content field yet.

name: Small vacuum oven
description: A laboratory oven that heats its chamber under vacuum for drying delicate samples.
notes: Rides on the microwave model in grey steel, as the reference lists it as a microwave variant. At 40.9 kg and 27 L it is much heavier than the shared model; set its mass from the reference when the drafts are applied. Vacuum drying has no content field yet.

name: Mortar and pestle
description: A heavy stone bowl and a club-shaped stone for crushing seeds, herbs and grain by hand.
notes: A stone-grey mortar 120 mm across with a deep bowl and a stone-whet pestle lying across its rim. milling stands for the reference's FINE_GRIND; hammering and cooking mirror its HAMMER and BOIL qualities.

name: Multi-cooker
description: An electric pressure pot with a locking lid and a panel of cooking programmes.
notes: 250 mm wide and 245 mm tall: a steel-stainless body on a black base, a black locking lid with a grey steam valve and a float pin, two side handles and a sloped front panel with a dark display and five buttons. The cord is a separate plug-in, so the back shows only an empty socket. The box is 3.9 times the reference's 3.75 L; the reference's 11.3 kg is about twice a real one. cooking 2 is added for what it does; the reference gives only CONTAIN. Its programmes have no content field yet.

name: Multi-cooker (cooking)
description: An electric pressure pot with its lid locked and a meal cooking inside.
notes: The running state of the multi-cooker: the same model with its display lit in lcd-green. It exists only while cooking, so it never spawns. Turning back into the plain cooker when done has no content field yet.

name: Kerosene stove
description: A pressure stove that burns kerosene from a round tank under its burner. Pump it up before lighting.
notes: 150 mm across and 170 mm tall: a steel-grey tank with a brass filler cap, a pump with a black knob, a brass control valve, a brass riser and burner head under an iron-cast spreader, and four parkerised pot supports on uprights. The reference gives no quality; heating 2 is added for what it does. Kerosene fuel has no content field yet.

name: Hand oil press
description: A small hand-cranked screw press that squeezes oil out of seeds and nuts. A burner under the barrel warms it.
notes: 200 mm long and 150 mm tall: a steel-stainless barrel on a steel bench clamp with a funnel hopper on top, a crank arm with a birch knob, a press-cake nozzle, an oil spout and a brass burner cup with a cotton wick under the barrel. pressing reuses the name the hydraulic press workstation declares, at a lower level.

name: Oil-fired hand oil press
description: A crude hand-cranked screw press warmed by an oil lamp, for squeezing oil from seeds.
notes: Rides on the hand press model in cast iron with an oak knob. The reference weighs it at 12 kg and 20 L, far bigger than the shared model; set its mass from the reference when the drafts are applied. A crafted item, so it never spawns.

name: Pasta extruder
description: A cast-iron press that clamps to a table edge. Turning the crank forces dough out through a shaped die.
notes: A vertical iron-cast barrel 72 mm across with a bench clamp and thumbscrew at the back, a steel die at the bottom, and a threaded plunger driven through a bridge by a T-crank with walnut knobs; 230 mm tall plus the clamp screw. pasta_extruding is a new quality name; the reference gives none. Interchangeable dies have no content field yet.

name: Jar of fermenting pickles
description: A jar of cucumbers fermenting in brine under a tied cloth. Seal it once they turn sour.
notes: A glass-clear jar 100 mm across and 132 mm tall holding six leaf-green cucumbers and a dill sprig in syrup-green brine, with cotton cloth tied over the mouth. The tiles draw the glass opaque, so the cucumbers show only in the game. The mass includes the jar. A crafted state, so it never spawns; turning into sealed pickles over time has no content field yet.

name: Soda can stove kit
description: A tiny alcohol stove cut from two drink cans, with a simmer ring and a plastic bottle for fuel.
notes: An alu-bare can stove 66 mm across with a dark ring of jet holes and a simmer ring with a tab resting on it, beside an empty 500 ml plastic-clear bottle with a paper label and blue cap. The box is 3.5 times the reference's 750 ml because of the bottle. The reference gives no quality; heating 1 is added for what it does. Alcohol fuel has no content field yet.

name: Propane stove
description: A single camp burner with fold-out pot supports and a regulator for a propane cylinder.
notes: 180 mm across and 100 mm tall: a paint-green bowl on three parkerised legs, a stainless burner with dark ports under an iron-cast cap, four pot supports, and a brass regulator and coupler reaching out to +x with a black knob. The cylinder is a separate item. Fuel has no content field yet.

name: Biogas stove
description: A camp burner refitted to run on gas from a digester.
notes: Rides on the propane stove model with a bare steel bowl in place of the green paint. A converted item, so it never spawns. Biogas fuel has no content field yet.

name: Stone quern
description: Two round millstones, the upper one turned by a wooden handle to grind grain into flour.
notes: 300 mm across: a stone-grey bed stone with a spout lip, a stone-whet runner stone with a dark feed hole, a chalk-white line of flour at the joint and an oak handle peg. At 31.5 kg it stays where it is set down, so it is a workstation; milling is a new quality name for grinding grain. The size is a placeholder for a thing too heavy to carry far. A crafted item, but Tier1 Residential stands in for an old one found in a farmhouse.

name: Jar of fermenting sauerkraut
description: A jar of shredded cabbage fermenting under a stone weight and a tied cloth. Seal it once it turns sour.
notes: The same jar as the fermenting pickles, holding a straw-pale mass of cabbage in jelly-pale brine under a stone-grey weight, with cotton cloth tied over the mouth. The tiles draw the glass opaque, so the contents show only in the game. The mass includes the jar. A crafted state, so it never spawns; turning into sealed sauerkraut over time has no content field yet.
